fields.process: First notice of loss to claim decision
fields.scope: Starts when a customer reports a loss, ends when the claim is settled, declined or referred to SIU

nodes.title: Loss reported (FNOL)
nodes.detail: Customer reports a loss by phone or through the portal

nodes.title: Claim registered in ClaimCenter
nodes.detail: Agent keys the claim into the claims core and attaches documents

nodes.title: Rules-based fraud screening
nodes.detail: Static rule set flags claims for SIU referral overnight

nodes.title: Triage and assign
nodes.detail: Claim segmented by value and complexity, routed to a handling queue

nodes.title: Assess and decide
nodes.detail: Handler gathers history, validates cover and reaches a decision

nodes.title: Settle, decline or refer to SIU
nodes.detail: Payment released, claim declined, or file passed to investigations

nodes.title: Manual re-keying at intake
nodes.detail: 12 min per claim; transcription errors surface later as rework

nodes.title: Rule set misses organised fraud
nodes.detail: Est. 30% of fraud undetected; average detection lag 45 days

nodes.title: Handler rebuilds claim history by hand
nodes.detail: ~2h/day across the team searching policy and prior claims

nodes.title: Recovery opportunities spotted too late
nodes.detail: Subrogation potential missed in ~15% of eligible claims

nodes.title: Guidewire ClaimCenter (on-prem)
nodes.detail: Claim records since 2016; REST APIs rate-limited, FNOL events exported nightly only

nodes.title: Synapse data warehouse
nodes.detail: 3 years of labelled SIU outcomes; refreshed nightly

nodes.title: Policy admin (Azure)
nodes.detail: Policy and customer history; API available

nodes.title: Loss report documents
nodes.detail: Scanned PDFs and email, Danish-language, unstructured

nodes.title: Real-time fraud scoring at FNOL
nodes.detail: Scores every claim at intake and routes high-risk files straight to SIU

nodes.title: Claim document intake extraction
nodes.detail: Reads the loss report and pre-fills the claim record for the agent to confirm

nodes.title: Claim history summariser
nodes.detail: Drafts a claim-and-policy summary so the handler starts from a brief, not a search

nodes.title: Subrogation opportunity detection
nodes.detail: Flags recoverable claims while the file is still open

nodes.title: Works councils must be consulted
nodes.detail: Required before any go-live that changes adjuster work - brief in month 1

nodes.title: SIU referral thresholds have no owner
nodes.detail: Nobody in the room owns the threshold; the enterprise data office owns the claims data
